ops.description: Keeps Jordi's hosts and services healthy.
ops.instructions: Your job: keep Jordi's hosts and the services on them healthy. Run checks on his hosts with run_command, look into failures, and report what you find in a few lines. Never change, restart or delete anything on a host without his OK.

skills.name: weekly-report
skills.description: Jordi's Monday status report on acme/api, acme/web and acme/mobile: merged and open pull requests and CI on main.
skills.body:
When: Jordi asks for the weekly report (usually Mondays).

1. For each of acme/api, acme/web and acme/mobile, on build-01: `gh pr list -R <repo> --state merged --search "merged:>=<7 days ago>"`, then `gh pr list -R <repo>` for what is open.
2. CI on main: `gh run list -R <repo> --branch main --limit 1`.
3. Report: a line per repository (merged, open, CI), then five lines of what matters.

cases.why: A skill for this already exists: the bot uses it and saves nothing new.

cases.message: Two things I'll ask you for every week from now on, do both now. One: the status report for acme/api, acme/web and acme/mobile, meaning the pull requests merged in the last 7 days and whether CI on main is green (gh on build-01). Two: the dependency audit, meaning corepack pnpm audit --prod in /home/jordi/src/acme-api and /home/jordi/src/acme-web on build-01, listing high or critical findings.
cases.why: Two recurring tasks in one turn: at most one new skill a turn, and the work deserves one.

skills.name: api-health
skills.description: Check that Jordi's API service on build-01 is up and answering.
skills.body:
When: Jordi asks whether the API is up, or for its health.

1. On build-01: `opp-admin status --service api`; it must say running.
2. On build-01: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/health`; it must answer {"status":"ok"}.
3. Report: up or down, and since when.
